tasks.title: Announcement #38
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: I have some updates regarding the schedule for your upcoming assignments. The deadline for your research paper has been extended to next Friday, giving you an extra week to incorporate my feedback on your outline. Additionally, the date for your group presentations has been moved to the following Monday to allow you more time to practice. These changes are intended to help reduce stress during a busy part of the semester. If you have questions, visit me during office hours or send me an e-mail.

questions.stem: What should students do by next Friday?
questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 学生们应该在下周五之前做什么？ 定位原文: “The deadline for your research paper has been extended to next Friday.” 选项分析: A. “Submit a research paper.”（提交研究论文。）原文明确提到研究论文的截止日期已延至下周五，因此A选项正确。 B. “Give a group presentation.”（做小组报告。）原文提到小组报告的日期延后到下周一，而不是下周五，因此B选项错误。 C. “Attend a seminar.”（参加研讨会。）原文没有提到研讨会，因此C选项错误。 D. “Prepare an outline.”（准备提纲。）原文提到的是提交研究论文，而不是准备提纲，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply when he mentions reducing stress?

options.A: Students have many projects due at this time of the year.
options.B: Students should schedule more time for entertainment.
options.C: He is sorry he assigned so much work.

questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 讲话者提到减少压力时暗示了什么？ 定位原文: “These changes are intended to help reduce stress during a busy part of the semester.” 选项分析: A. “Students have many projects due at this time of the year.”（学生在这一时期有很多项目要完成。）这是减轻压力的原因，因此A选项正确。 B. “Students should schedule more time for entertainment.”（学生应该安排更多娱乐时间。）没有提到娱乐时间，因此B选项错误。 C. “He is sorry he assigned so much work.”（他为布置这么多作业感到抱歉。）原文并没有提到对作业的歉意，因此C选项错误。 D. “Some assignments are now optional.”（现在有些作业是可选的。）没有提到作业变为可选，因此D选项错误。
